text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild pancytopenia (anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia), and abnormal white cell differential (lymphopenia, monocytosis, basophilia). There is also mild hyperferritinemia, elevated INR, and slightly increased chloride. Inflammatory markers (CRP, procalcitonin, D-dimer) are not significantly elevated. Findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or systemic illness; clinical correlation and further evaluation for hypoxemia and cytopenias are recommended.
